mapper.select:
select count(*)from tb_user where 1=1
and date_format(create_time,'%Y-%m-%d')=date_format(#{date},'%Y-%m-%d')
and date_format(create_time,'%Y-%m')=date_format(#{date},'%Y-%m')
and date_format(create_time,'%Y')=date_format(#{date},'%Y')

select sum(money) from pay_details where `state`=1
and date_format(create_time,'%Y-%m-%d')=date_format(#{date},'%Y-%m-%d')
and date_format(create_time,'%Y-%m')=date_format(#{date},'%Y-%m')
and date_format(create_time,'%Y')=date_format(#{date},'%Y')

select * from ( select c.course_id as courseId,sum(o.pay_money) as 'coursemoney' ,count(*) as 'coursenum',any_value(c.title) as 'coursename' from orders o , course c where o.course_id=c.course_id and o.status=1 and o.orders_type=1
and date_format(o.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d')=date_format(#{date},'%Y-%m-%d')
and date_format(o.create_time,'%Y-%m')=date_format(#{date},'%Y-%m')
and date_format(o.create_time,'%Y')=date_format(#{date},'%Y')
group by c.course_id ) a order by a.coursenum desc

select count(*) from tb_user where is_vip=1
and date_format(create_time,'%Y-%m-%d')=date_format(#{date},'%Y-%m-%d')
and date_format(create_time,'%Y-%m')=date_format(#{date},'%Y-%m')
and date_format(create_time,'%Y')=date_format(#{date},'%Y')

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS newUserCount FROM tb_user WHERE DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d')
mapper.update: update tb_user set cash_deposit=0.00, user_name=null, identity_card_front=null, identity_card_number=null, identity_card_verso=null, check_certification=null, check_certification_message=null, audit_time=null where user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: select * from (select (st_distance(point(r.lng, r.lat), point(#{lng}, #{lat})) * 111195) as distance, t.* from rider_location r left join tb_user t on t.user_id = r.user_id where t.user_type = 2 and t.on_line_flag = 1 ) a where distance <= #{distance}

SELECT * FROM (SELECT u.*, (st_distance(POINT(r.lng, r.lat), POINT(#{lng}, #{lat})) * 111195) AS distance, (select count(0) from sys_indent s where s.rider_user_id = u.user_id and s.indent_state in (0, 1, 2)) as indentCount FROM tb_user u, rider_location r WHERE u.user_id = r.user_id and u.on_line_flag = 1 and u.status = 1) AS t1 where t1.distance <= #{range} * 1000

select u.* from tb_user u,shops_user_role r
r.shop_id = #{shopId} and u.user_id= r.user_id
and u.user_name like concat("%",#{userEntity.userName},"%")
and u.phone like concat("%",#{userEntity.phone},"%")
order by r.create_time desc
select u.* from tb_user u where u.inviter_code=#{invitationCode} order by u.create_time desc

select u.user_name as userName, u.avatar as avatar, u.user_id as userId, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(money),0) FROM `user_money_details` m WHERE m.relation_id = u.user_id
AND m.user_level = 1
AND m.user_level = 2
)AS money FROM tb_user u, tb_user ua WHERE 1 = 1
and u.inviter_code = ua.invitation_code
and u.inviter_inviter_code = ua.invitation_code
and ua.user_id = #{userId} order by money desc
